policyTitle: Bariatric Surgery (Surgical Treatment of Morbid Obesity)

criteriaGroups.title: Primary Obesity Diagnosis
criteriaGroups.description: Documented diagnosis of morbid (severe) obesity on the problem list, confirmed by the treating physician.

candidateCodes.display: Morbid (severe) obesity due to excess calories
Other obesity due to excess calories

criteriaGroups.documentationRequired: Problem-list diagnosis of morbid obesity confirmed by the treating physician.

criteriaGroups.title: Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 35
criteriaGroups.description: Documented BMI of 35 kg/m² or greater within the past 12 months, supported by current weight and height measurements.
criteriaGroups.documentationRequired: Current height, weight, and calculated BMI ≥ 35 kg/m², recorded within the past 12 months.

criteriaGroups.title: Qualifying Comorbidity
criteriaGroups.description: At least one obesity-related comorbid condition documented as an active diagnosis.
criteriaGroups.documentationRequired: Active diagnosis of an obesity-related comorbidity (type 2 diabetes, hypertension, obstructive sleep apnea, obesity hypoventilation syndrome, pulmonary hypertension, NAFLD/NASH, GERD, weight-bearing osteoarthritis, dyslipidemia, PCOS, stress urinary incontinence, venous stasis disease, or pseudotumor cerebri).

criteriaGroups.title: Conservative Treatment Attempted (supportive)
criteriaGroups.description: Supervised medical weight management attempted for at least 6 months in the preceding 2 years. Supportive documentation — not required for all plans.
criteriaGroups.documentationRequired: Records of a physician-supervised diet, behavioral therapy, or pharmacotherapy program of at least 6 months within the past 2 years.

notes: Surgical readiness (age >= 18, pre-surgical psychological evaluation, no active substance use disorder, no uncontrolled psychiatric illness) is required per policy but is not derivable from structured Condition/Observation codes alone — verify via chart review and the psychological evaluation report rather than automated FHIR matching.
